scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw RCWA outputs is infeasible (checker cannot run RCWA); we compare reported enhancement values to paper reference with tolerances and audit spectrum shape.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference values for step_01 (optimal parameters), step_02 (enhancements at 455/550 nm), step_03 (spectrum peak window and 490 nm gold).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published optimal structure and computed enhancement values, serving as the reproduction target.

required.texture: string (one of: nanorod, inverted_rod, pyramid, inverted_pyramid)

outputs.description: Optimal texture type and geometric parameters that maximize yellow‑light extraction at 550 nm, as determined from the RCWA parameter sweep.
Light extraction efficiency enhancements at 455 nm and 550 nm for the optimal inverted pyramid, compared against hidden reference values from the paper.
Enhancement spectrum from 400 to 700 nm for the optimal inverted pyramid; audited for shape (peak near 550 nm, monotonic fall-off) and a hidden value around 490 nm.

output_contract.notes: All gold values are taken from the paper's Table 1 and Fig. 6b. The exact optimal parameters (texture, period, depth) are checked. Enhancement values at 455/550 nm are compared with tolerance. The spectrum is checked for structural consistency and a sample value at 490 nm.
